name: Sugihashi Junko
source:
She is a wife who lives in building B with her husband,

She is a cool person and had a history of refusing of going to school when she was a student.

She used to date her teacher and rumors started circulating which caused her to avoid going to school.

[spoiler] she sleeps with her father in law not because she wants to but for a few reasons. Her husband is impotent and her father in law is someone she knew in the past. Tooru helps put a stop to this with her. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bmwp.htmll]official site[/url]]
